events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the one and only John Cleese, who turns 87 today! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' on the world. A double album that truly broke new ground. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Fabs Classic
angles.copy: A true game-changer! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today, marking a pivotal moment in their career.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was tragically killed on this day in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost on this day in 1980. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Iconic British musician David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Forever a musical innovator and style icon.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the birth of a legend! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music still shakes the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind continues to inspire generations of guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, who celebrates his 82nd birthday today! A true icon with a voice instantly recognisable.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', was born on this day in 1956.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a generation.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: American country music legend, singer-songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon whose talent and generosity shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow was born on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to West End hits, a songwriting maestro.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean was born on this day in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes! It's Billy Ocean's 77th birthday today. Still 'Suddenly' feeling good!

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1989, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock History Made
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony. Who were you most excited to see inducted first?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming audiences with his distinctive style.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London on this day in 1969, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final public performance. An unforgettable moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, from Genesis to his solo superstardom.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake was born on this day in 1981.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Bringing 'SexyBack' and so much more! Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: English actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy in 'Only Fools and Horses', was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: All together now, 'Lovely jubbly!' Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' (1959)
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, an event famously known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Remembering the Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 'The Day The Music Died'. Their legacy lives on.
